versions.content: If a PDU with SoAdTxUdpTriggerMode set to TRIG- GER_NEVER without a specific SoAdTxUdpTriggerTimeout get buffered SoAd shall set the the nPdu specific timer to the value of SoAdTxUdpTriggerTimeout if the timer is not running or if it is lower than the current nPdu specific timer value.
